query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQC_USER_HISTORY(USER_SEQ, USER_ID, USER_NAME, PASSWORD, TRAN_TIME, SEC_GRP_ID, PHONE_OFFICE, PHONE_MOBILE, PHONE_HOME, PHONE_OTHER, EMAIL_ID, USER_CMF_1, USER_CMF_2, USER_CMF_3, USER_CMF_4, USER_CMF_5) VALUES(USER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, :strUserID, :strUserName, :strPass, :tran_time, :strPnOffice, :strPnMobile, :strPnHome, :strPnOther, :strEmail, :strGrp, :strUserCmf1, :strUserCmf2,:strUserCmf3,:strUserCmf4,:strUserCmf5)

-- Create Date : 2014-01-21 09:48:32 SELECT USER_CMF_1 AS STATUS, USER_SEQ, USER_ID, USER_NAME, TRAN_TIME, SEC_GRP_ID, PHONE_OFFICE, PHONE_MOBILE, PHONE_HOME, PHONE_OTHER, EMAIL_ID, USER_CMF_2 AS USER_SEC_GROUP FROM TQC_USER_HISTORY WHERE 1=1 AND TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(:st_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(:end_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') ORDER BY TRAN_TIME DESC

-- Create Date : 2014-01-24 09:28:43 SELECT USER_CMF_1 AS STATUS, USER_SEQ, USER_ID, USER_NAME, TRAN_TIME, SEC_GRP_ID, PHONE_OFFICE, PHONE_MOBILE, PHONE_HOME, PHONE_OTHER, EMAIL_ID FROM TQC_USER_HISTORY WHERE 1=1 AND TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(:st_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(:end_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AND USER_NAME = :user_name ORDER BY TRAN_TIME DESC

-- Create Date : 2014-01-27 16:24:27 SELECT USER_CMF_1 AS STATUS, USER_SEQ, USER_ID, USER_NAME, TRAN_TIME, SEC_GRP_ID, PHONE_OFFICE, PHONE_MOBILE, PHONE_HOME, PHONE_OTHER, EMAIL_ID FROM TQC_USER_HISTORY WHERE 1=1 AND TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(:st_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(:end_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AND USER_CMF_1 = 'Delete' ORDER BY TRAN_TIME DESC, USER_ID ASC
